problem: The verified artifact ledger imports transaction lifecycle implementation helpers even though transaction already depends on ledger. This single ledger-to-transaction edge keeps the whole ledger package inside the main SCC and reverses the intended authority direction.

options.name: Keep the pure draft model in transaction
options.correctness: Preserves behavior but leaves ledger coupled to transaction execution and the 12-package SCC unchanged.

options.name: Move the pure TransactionDraft contract to operations and retain a transaction compatibility export
options.correctness: Keeps one canonical implementation, preserves every public transaction import, and makes ledger depend only on a neutral operation contract rather than transaction execution.
options.complexity: Six governed paths including one new contract module, one compatibility shim, one ledger import, cumulative architecture tests and one responsibility record.
options.migration: Record expected-red, move the existing pure model unchanged to operations.draft, replace transaction.model with explicit re-exports, redirect ledger imports, and make the B2 count assertion monotonic.
options.rollback: Restore transaction.model implementation and ledger imports, remove operations.draft, and restore the exact B2 count.
options.verification: Transaction protocol tests, ledger regression, Architecture Gate, full Quick, lifecycle and Chromium.

options.name: Make ledger own transaction draft lifecycle
options.correctness: Would remove the edge but incorrectly transfers transaction lifecycle authority into the artifact ledger.

rejected_reasons.keep-transaction-owned-model: It preserves the reversed dependency and blocks the SCC elimination goal.
rejected_reasons.move-draft-authority-into-ledger: Ledger must not become the Owner of authorization, commit or transaction execution.

deletions: The concrete TransactionDraft implementation is removed from agent_core.transaction.model and replaced by compatibility exports; no public transaction symbol is deleted.
unknowns: The remaining 11-package SCC remains open debt.
Real model certification remains outside this structural migration.
selected_responsibilities: agent_core.operations.draft owns the pure effect-bearing TransactionDraft data algebra.
agent_core.transaction owns authority, persistence, reconciliation and commit orchestration and re-exports the draft contract for compatibility.
agent_core.ledger stores and projects verified carriers but does not import transaction execution.
preserved_hard_invariants: Draft states, command payload canonicalization and command digest outputs remain byte-for-byte behaviorally equivalent.
Ledger schema and presentation projection remain unchanged.
rag and utils remain outside the main SCC.
The dependency debt baseline is not edited.
cutover_strategy: Create the red architecture contract before implementation, move the pure code without semantic edits, retain an explicit compatibility module, redirect only ledger imports, then run complete product verification.
acceptance_claims: ledger has no transaction package import and is absent from the main SCC.
operations.draft is the only implementation Owner while transaction.model is a compatibility export.
The current SCC member count is 11 and cannot regress above prior verified bounds.
Transaction, frontend, lifecycle and browser behavior remain green.
